_docs._: Optional. Copy to config.json next to code_search.py and keep only the keys you change. Keys that start with _ are ignored. These values are the built-in defaults. A change takes effect at the next index build.
_docs.model: Hugging Face embedding model. Downloaded once to the Hugging Face cache.
_docs.mode: LEANN embedding backend. sentence-transformers runs the model locally.
_docs.query_prompt: Prefix added to search queries only, for instruction-tuned models such as Qwen3-Embedding. Set it to an empty string for models without one.
_docs.ruby: Ruby chunker. prism: one chunk per method plus class-body chunks (needs Ruby 3.3+; without one, Ruby files fall back to line windows). text: LEANN's stock splitter. treesitter: LEANN's AST chunker, which needs an astchunk build with Ruby support.
_docs.other: Chunker for non-Ruby code. lines: line windows with a path:line-range header. text: LEANN's stock splitter. Markdown always uses the stock splitter.
_docs.vector_weight: Weight of vector similarity in LEANN's search score. 1.0 is pure vector search.
_docs.ruby_max_chars: Max characters per chunk for Prism and line-window chunks. Longer methods are split into overlapping parts.
_docs.max_seq_length: Max tokens embedded per chunk. Longer chunks are truncated. Lower values build faster and use less memory.
